correctness.rationale: Rosser–Schoenfeld uniform n/φ(n)≤e^γ loglog n+O(1/loglog n) and quantitative PNT give F(n)=φ(n)/π(n)≥y/(e^γ log y)(1−O((log y)^−2)), y=log n. Along primorials, effective Mertens/PNT give matching F(P)=y/(e^γ log y)(1+o((log y)^−2)); gaps in log successive primorials O(log y)=o(k). Since (φ−π+ω)/(π−ω)=F−1+o(1), bracketing y=e^γ k(log k+loglog k+γ±ε) proves both log N_k and log M_k with o(k) remainders, no RH. Checked the inversion algebra independently at k=10^3,10^5,10^8.
residual_risks: Threshold expansion does not prove exact N_k/M_k or their conjectured equality; finite numerical inversion is not proof.
